page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8is.2xlarge is an accelerated compute instance within the Compute Optimized with GPU family, provisioned through the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 8 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor clocked at 3.3 GHz. System memory is configured at 64.0 GB, yielding a high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single NVIDIA L20 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance contains no bundled local storage, meaning all persistent data and operating file systems rely entirely on external network-attached block storage. Network baseline bandwidth is rated at 8 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned.

Resource allocation couples a large GPU memory footprint with an elevated system memory-to-core ratio, which serves well for memory-heavy accelerator tasks without paying for higher core counts. However, storage throughput is bounded by external network volume capabilities due to the absence of integrated NVMe drives. The instance is structured for deep learning inference, model fine-tuning, image and video processing, and GPU-driven analytical workloads.
